title: MCP server cross-flow: gmail injection content forwarded into github issue
description: Synthetic case demonstrating N2 cross-server toxic flow. Agent reads email via gmail MCP server; email body contains injection language. Agent forwards content into github MCP server's create_issue call, completing the indirect-prompt-injection chain across server boundaries.
source_notes: v0.20.0 N2 detector validation. Pattern observed in real-world MCP usage where agents naively forward read-tool output into write-tool input.

expected_findings.note: Co-fires with N2 — same injection language fires both detectors. Documenting that they can both legitimately match this content.
